title: Unit test 'device ACL requires device or nonzero master token' fails on master
summary: indigo_test/unit/test_protocol_security.c device_acl_requires_device_or_nonzero_master_token fails deterministically on master ddd7ad5b6 without any task change, so make -C indigo_test test-unit stops there and does not run the suites after it. Either the device/master token ACL in the XML/JSON request parsers or the test expectation regressed; not investigated in the origin task, which does not touch the protocol code. Next: find which of the four assertions fails, bisect since d02bc87dc, fix and rerun the unit suite.
evidence: Origin task verification.md: build/unit/test_protocol_security reports FAIL for this case three times in a row and again after stashing the task changes and rebuilding libindigo from master; the other 34 unit suites pass.
